objective: Retire reviewed completed-use payloads and successful raw profilers, then bounded numerical localization without weakening thresholds.

cleanup.requires: reviewed per-file immutable manifest, successful relevant results, no live dependency, preserved small results and terminal facts; no whole-worktree removal

diagnostics.inputs: retained FFN medium anchor, baseline/W vjp1 and update1/2
questions: original failures and first-step gradient differences
independent scalar Decimal AdamW replay from real update1
sequential counterfactual propagation of parameter/moment/gradient differences; no unique causal fraction

diagnostics.device: cpu first; idle NPU only if needed
questions: selected meaningful same-input value/VJP and gradient ownership checks
first differing upstream boundary if saved gradients alone do not explain cause
diagnostics.scope: one or two bounded witnesses, no full-path dump matrix

diagnostics.inputs: fixed original shared9B seed751/input752, B8 prompt128/chunk32/decode16, region_batch1/4
questions: first received/score/support/int64 difference in canonical node coordinates
same-input allocation replay and independent scalar formula

diagnostics.scope: at most one original X or narrow-KV third-update witness if practical; no whole failed matrix

stop_conditions: first concrete localized mechanism or bounded unresolved witness

other: all unresolved failure inputs until validated smaller reproducer exists
original tolerance failures and previously observed support/time differences

lifecycle: commit tools before formal run; git archive frozen source; background.slice finite jobs with persistent logs; inspect tracked descendants; evidence separate commit; normal push only
